title: What did Adam Sandler say about Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift while promoting 'Happy Gilmore 2'? - NewsBreak
text: Adam Sandler gushed about Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce in a new interview. While the Murder Mystery actor was promoting his upcoming film Happy Gilmore 2 , he was asked about Swift and Kelce, and his response was warm and kind. Speaking with Entertainment Tonight on July 16, 2025, Sandler when asked if his kids have met Taylor Swift, he said yes and added that "she was ridiculously nice and warm." ​ Adam Sandler also talked about Kansas City Chiefs player Travis Kelce, who is dating Swift and is expected to make a cameo in the film: ​ Sandler also described Kelce as “a great actor and great human.” Sandler, who starred in the hit movie Happy Gilmore in 1996, is back for a second part. The movie stars Christopher McDonald, Julie Bowen, Ben Stiller, Bad Bunny, and Benny Safdie. The first film followed the story of Happy Gilmore, who, by sheer force of will, tries to gather money to stop his grandmother’s house from being foreclosed. In the upcoming movie, Happy, a retired golfer returns to the tournament almost thirty years after his first win in a bid to raise money to pay for his daughter Vienna’s ballet school fees. Adam Sandler, whose two daughters, Sadie, 19 and Sunny, 16, are expected to have acting roles in the upcoming Happy Gilmore 2 movie, spoke about working with them in E!
